searchText: Absolutely, I have ~500 lines of go in a script which traces block execution using turbogeth, and another ~60 lines of python to analyze the results. I'll share them this week! Great, thanks! Nice analysis. Will be good to get the results validated for correctness. It doesn't mean very much but, I think this lines up with my "gut". It'd be nice to ratchet this up to a million blocks or so to see how the long tail behaves. Same with just having a list of block numbers and the "oldest" state touched in each.
